JavaScript with multiple exports, verify export count

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"javascript\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("export function greet() { return 'hi'; }\nexport const VERSION = '1.0';\nexport default class App {}\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
